title: FE mass-spring base white noise: exact absolute RMS and Miles approximation
source: Newland, An Introduction to Random Vibrations, Spectral and Wavelet Analysis, 3rd ed. (1993), linear system spectral response; independently integrated SDOF rational transfer, derivation in README.md.

quantities.reason: Trapezoidal PSD quadrature on a fixed fine grid against an independent closed-form integral; tolerance fixed before execution.
Miles is a narrow-resonance approximation; at zeta=.02 the exact finite-band RMS exceeds Miles by about 0.08%, so 0.1% compares the FE result to the approximation without treating Miles as exact.
